propositions: Missing author-facing repair surface for retroactive commit linking via `rebar attach-commits` CLI verb, library, and MCP tool
Batch SHA validation must be all-or-nothing: if any SHA is invalid, no COMMITS event is recorded and an error names all offenders

Close-gate deterministic check must verify that linked commits' changed paths are covered by declared file_impact, with exemption globs (tests/**, docs/**, **/*.md, CHANGELOG.md) and directory-prefix matching
Path matchers must implement repo-relative POSIX matching with **/‐aware glob semantics, reusing a shared DET module that does not import rebar.llm
Merge commits must be explicitly skipped (not misread as empty path lists); source-(ii) commits fail closed on git errors, source-(i) SHAs are skipped if absent locally
file_impact union scope must match discovery scope (ticket and transitive descendants) to avoid false blocks when parent declares file_impact while child commits own paths
